coin.name: Dynasty
coin.description: DYNASTY is the ecosystem token of Dynasty 8, a fan-made GTA VI-inspired property-token catalogue. Creator fees from every property coin buy back and burn DYNASTY through a public, multisig-controlled Demolition Fund. Not affiliated with Rockstar Games or Take-Two. Speculative digital asset.

feeSharing.setup: After the Pump launch: register the mint, then /admin/treasury -> 'Fee sharing for a launched coin', signed by creatorWallet (sweep if needed, create_fee_sharing_config, update_fee_shares_v2; locks the split).

coin.registration: POST /api/admin/ecosystem/token {mintAddress} -> PENDING_VERIFICATION, then POST /api/admin/tokens/{id}/verify after review -> LIVE. Buybacks refuse to run until DYNASTY is LIVE with a fresh market snapshot.
pending: D-NATIVE-FEES: where DYNASTY's own creator fees go. Configured here as the same 60/25/15 vault split; the backend does not book them as buyback revenue (they would sit in the vaults until the owner decides).
D-LAUNCH-DEVBUY: initial buy size (0 by default).
Square logo artwork (the bundled logo is 1024x515).
